events.text: Analyst request: several cards this month show purchases from the same unusual device profile. Review transaction 3478561 on card C13487-K1 and look for related activity.

events.msg: Core toolkit: flagged transaction, card window, card baseline, recurring charges, resolved account history, device neighbours, region activity and prior cases

hypotheses: The transaction is part of a coordinated fraud campaign (e.g., carding or account takeover) where a fraudster uses a shared device profile and anonymous proxies to make unauthorized purchases across multiple compromised cards.

The transaction is a legitimate online purchase by the cardholder who is using a VPN/proxy and a common mobile device profile, which explains the channel shift and the shared device profile signature.
The cardholder's card details were compromised and used individually, and the shared device profile is a false positive resulting from a highly common user-agent and screen resolution configuration.

calls.why: To analyze the 19 other cards and customers associated with this specific device profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080) and determine if they have confirmed fraud cases or shared attributes.
To review the full transaction history of card C13487-K1 around the flagged date, checking for other unusual online transactions or verifying if normal in-person activity resumed.

events.msg: Four specialist analysts reviewing their evidence in parallel

events.assessment: Transaction 3478561 is highly anomalous and indicates card-not-present fraud. The card's baseline is almost exclusively in-person (69 out of 71 transactions), whereas the flagged transaction is online, uses an anonymous proxy, and is linked to a device profile associated with 114 transactions across the system.
key_points: Transaction 3478561 ($74.96) is an online, product 'C' transaction, which deviates significantly from the card's historical baseline of 69 in-person transactions out of 71 total.
The flagged transaction utilized an anonymous proxy (IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS) and a mobile device profile linked to 114 transactions across the network, indicating a shared fraud tool or botnet.

The card was used in person shortly before (3477218) and shortly after (3478886) the flagged online transaction, suggesting the physical card remains in the owner's possession while the card details were compromised online.

events.assessment: Transaction 3478561 on card C13487-K1 was initiated from a newly observed mobile device profile utilizing an anonymous proxy. The associated account has no prior transaction history, indicating a high likelihood of fraudulent activity. The use of an anonymous proxy to mask the user's true location on a new account strongly suggests unauthorized card-not-present activity.
key_points: The transaction was made on card C13487-K1 (account ID C13487-K1|191.0|143) which has no prior history (n_txn: 1).
The device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' is flagged as 'New' and was seen only once on this card.
An anonymous proxy ('IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS') was used during the transaction.
The unnamed model feature id_34 returned 'match_status:2'.

events.assessment: A single device profile is linked to 52 cards all-time, showing rapid successive online transactions across multiple distinct card accounts within a few days. The use of an anonymous proxy across all these transactions strongly indicates a coordinated card-not-present fraud ring or card testing operation.
key_points: The device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' is shared across 52 cards all-time, indicating a highly suspicious shared infrastructure.

Between November 14 and November 18, 2016, multiple distinct cards including C10326-K1 (transactions 3457285, 3457521), C13487-K1 (transaction 3460634), and C08168-K1 (transaction 3461032) transacted using this device.
All transactions were routed through an anonymous proxy (IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS), which is a common technique for masking location in fraud rings.

events.assessment: An evaluation of transaction 3478561 on card C13487-K1 reveals no historical closed cases or similar patterns within the provided evidence. Without additional transaction details or device profile data, we cannot verify the reported unusual device activity or link it to other cards. Therefore, the risk is currently assessed as low due to the lack of prior adverse history, though significant information gaps remain.
key_points: No closed cases were found associated with the customer or card C13487-K1 in the provided evidence.
The query for similar transactions by pattern returned no results, leaving transaction 3478561 isolated.
There is no available data in the evidence regarding the unusual device profile mentioned in the alert.

events.claim: The session was routed through an anonymous proxy

The same device profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080) was used on 19 other card(s) of 19 other customer(s) between 2016-11-14 and 2016-11-22, 24 of those uses as a New device, 24 behind an anonymising proxy. The profile appears on only 52 card(s) in the whole dataset
